visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young boys stand and sit at a white circular table in a modern living room filled with scattered toys. The older boy in a striped shirt stands, curiously inspecting a small green container, while the younger toddler in a cream-colored shirt sits nearby amidst tissues and markers. (2) A sharp transition shows a young woman with dark hair and bangs, wearing a pink knit sweater, looking directly into the lens with a playful, knowing expression against a plain indoor background. (3) A chaotic scene unfolds on a large grey sofa; the toddler in a yellow romper climbs up the cushions, subsequently tumbles off, and is quickly gathered into his mother's arms as she wears a light pink robe. (4) The footage cuts to the older boy standing motionless facing a white wall next to a hallway, suggesting a disciplinary time-out. Later, the brothers sit at a low table where the older boy draws diligently in a sketchbook while the younger one reaches out to grab the markers. (5) In a final sequence on a grey padded mat, the older brother lies atop the younger one in an intense hug. The toddler's face is visibly distressed and red while the mother leans down to kiss them both. The scene concludes with the toddler struggling as the older boy continues to pin him down playfully.

The speech rate is rapid, conveying high energy and excitement. The mother's narration becomes more animated and rhythmic, matching the tempo of the BGM. (3) The mix becomes dense with short, percussive sound effects like "whooshes" and "pops" that highlight specific visual actions. Background noises include the clattering of toys on a hard floor and the muffled chatter of children yelling. (4) The audio features a strategic one-second silence followed by a comedic "boing" sound effect. The narrator's tone shifts to a softer, more melodic prosody as she expresses affection, though the BGM remains constant in the background. (5) The final phase is dominated by the younger child's loud, distressed vocalization with high spectral tension and breathiness. The narration concludes with a playful, lower-pitched remark as a final melodic stinger marks the end of the track.
